messages:
maria: heads up — users hitting runtime errors when importing the JS SDK directly in Deno. stack: `Uncaught TypeError: Invalid import.meta.resolve` and `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND` depending on how they bundle. repro: `import { Redwood } from 'https://cdn.example.com/redwood-sdk@1.2.0/mod.js'`

sam: ugh. is this the ESM-only package with an `exports` map? Deno doesn't honor Node's conditional exports the same way.

maria: yeah our package.json uses exports with conditions for node/browser. Deno tries to resolve and fails. also `fetch`-based auth flow expects `Headers.get/set` nuance — Bun/Deno subtle differences.

eli: two quick paths: publish a deno entrypoint under an explicit path (e.g., `mod.deno.ts`) or provide an import-map + CDN shim. We should avoid relying on Node conditionals in the main exports.

jules: i'm prototyping a minimal change on `devex/deno-compat` — adding a `./deno` export that points to `dist/deno/mod.ts` and a tiny wrapper that uses globalThis.fetch when available. patch snippet:```json
"exports": {
  ".": {"import": "./dist/index.mjs", "deno": "./dist/deno/mod.ts"},
  "./deno": "./dist/deno/mod.ts"
}
```
will also add `@deno-types` triple-slash to the mod.ts so TS users in Deno have types.

sam: nice. for Bun: watch out, Bun's `fetch` implementation returns a `Body` that behaves slightly different for `clone()`; our retry middleware clones responses currently which caused a leak in long lived streams. can we change retry to buffer small bodies or use `tee()`?

jules: changed retry to stream-compatible variant in the branch:```js
// fallback: only clone if body used, otherwise use response.text() for small responses
const text = await response.clone().text();
// replaced with: const text = await response.text();
```
should be safe for the metadata endpoints.

eli: CI heads-up — will add deno + bun matrix to the sdk pipeline. ci-bot: please run `deno test --unstable` and `bun test` in matrix.

ci-bot: deno-compat job started. first run failing on webcrypto differences in `crypto.subtle.importKey` (IE: Deno requires `format: 'raw'` vs Node accepts `spki`). Logging results to the PR. :robot_face:

maria: thx. i'll add a small sample app under `examples/deno-quickstart` showing `import 'https://cdn.redwood.com/redwood-sdk/deno/mod.ts'` + simple auth header example. also update quickstart docs to mention `--compat` flags where necessary.

sam: can we add a tiny note on DX doc: "If using Deno/Bun from the CDN, prefer the `deno` entrypoint or pin the dist/deno path; Node conditional exports may not work in edge runtimes." short & explicit.

jules: opening PR with the exports + retry fix + example. will tag y'all for review. PR links and CI logs incoming. :shipit:

maria: nice. once merged i'll coordinate a release and add a short announce blurb to devex and docs. thanks all! :raised_hands:
